decisions.before: Add Trial, Add Site, Submit Schedule, Protocol Review
decisions.after: One primary Add Trial button plus a three-item Quick actions group.
decisions.why: All four are existing workflow entries; none is redundant.

decisions.before: Total Trials, Total Sites, Total Patients, Total PIs
decisions.after: Four compact clickable totals with the same destinations.
decisions.why: The first concept omitted a PI total and made some directories harder to reach.

decisions.after: Home / My Trials / Messages / Calendar / Me.
decisions.why: The first concept wrongly replaced Messages with Patients. Patient access stays on home and trial detail.

decisions.before: Dashboard / Patients / Actions / Messages / Calendar / Me.
decisions.after: Six compact, minimum 44px touch targets. No destination removed.
decisions.why: CRC has a distinct Actions entry; do not force its footer into the PI navigation model.

decisions.before: Footer Edit Trial / Download Protocol and overflow Edit / Download.
decisions.after: One labeled Trial actions menu containing Edit Trial and Download Protocol; documents retain per-file downloads.
decisions.why: Same edit/download handlers are repeated. Consolidate duplicate triggers, not the capabilities.

decisions.before: KIT date records, decisions, events and anchors; separate legacy tasks/comments route.
decisions.after: Current KIT schedule first; existing legacy detail kept as its own pattern.
decisions.why: They operate on different saved facts. Visual unification is not permission to change scheduling behavior.

decisions.before: Taken, Not taken, Skip, Later; corrections, schedule and history.
decisions.after: Four dose outcomes plus Today / Schedule / History and correction panel.
decisions.why: A generic Reminder button would lose real functionality.

decisions.before: medication-reminder redirects to My Trial → medications → today.
decisions.after: One Medications destination; old route stays a redirect.
decisions.why: Avoid designing a second disconnected reminder system.

decisions.before: JSON/CSV export, channel retention, reports, preferences, entity change, language and support.
decisions.after: Named More / Account / Channel info groups, with destructive actions separated.
decisions.why: Frequency is not evidence that a capability is unimportant.

decisions.before: Current ScheduleVersionsScreen includes parity acceptance and bidirectional read-mode controls.
decisions.after: Advanced Schedule source & parity section with existing reason, readiness and role gates.
decisions.why: Current source supersedes the older no-product-surface note. Do not remove or activate them through a visual refresh.

decisions.before: Developer workbench; unreferenced legacy invite screen; redirect trial-detail.
decisions.after: Preserve source and existing redirects, exclude from ordinary product navigation.
decisions.why: Do not create new access to a route merely because its file exists.

decisions.before: Visit completion/outcome controls; audit queries, CAPAs, consent, decision sign-off.
decisions.after: Place at the record where their consequences are visible; retain current permission/confirmation checks.
decisions.why: Do not treat conditional or destructive actions as clutter.
